verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm you can request that the operator open and scan a letter's contents, beyond just viewing the envelope, and view it from phone or computer. Operators capture images with scanners or mobile devices. Nothing in the evidence says scans are searchable PDFs or states any turnaround time. Missing for 10: searchable PDF/OCR output, a stated same- or next-business-day scan turnaround, independent or hands-on corroboration.
